name: 8bitcn/ui
summary: Retro 8-bit shadcn/ui components and blocks for React — including health bars, XP bars and game-ready pieces — plus copy-paste themes.
description: A shadcn registry of accessible, retro-styled components and blocks. The component set mirrors shadcn/ui in 8-bit style (accordion, alert, button, calendar, card, carousel, chart, dialog, drawer, dropdown menu, input, menubar, navigation menu, pagination, select, sidebar, slider, switch, table, tabs, toast, tooltip …) and adds retro-specific pieces: enemy health display, health bar, mana bar, XP bar, kbd, retro mode switcher and theme selector. v2 adds 35 new blocks (hero, pricing, timeline, team, FAQ, 404, loading and game screens) and hand-picked 8-bit themes copy-paste into your app.
contains: 121 registry items: components, blocks and themes
shadcn-style component set in 8-bit style incl. health bar, mana bar, XP bar, enemy health display, kbd
retro extras: retro mode switcher, theme selector, combo box, resizable panels
v2 adds 35 blocks: hero, pricing, timeline, team, FAQ, 404, loading and game screens
hand-picked 8-bit themes to copy-paste into apps
installs as a trusted shadcn registry, with optional MCP setup for AI assistants
built on shadcn/ui; MIT licensed and open source
